description: This file defines the ShortcutListFragment class, which manages and displays a list of app shortcuts within an Android application, including functionalities such as fetching, sorting, launching, and pinning shortcuts.

classes.name: ShortcutListFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a list of shortcuts for selected applications and handles user interactions such as launching and pinning shortcuts.

methods.name: setArguments
methods.description: Initializes arguments for the fragment with target package, activity, user preferences, and display options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes services and adapter, checks for necessary permissions.

methods.name: getTargetUsers
methods.description: Returns the list of user profiles to query shortcuts for.

methods.name: togglePin
methods.description: Pins or unpins the selected shortcut.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Fetches, sorts, and updates the list of shortcuts displayed.
